name: AI Hair Color Changer
tagline: Free AI hair color changer with instant color and hairstyle previews
description: AI Hair Color Changer is a free online studio for previewing hair colors and hairstyles before committing to a salon visit. Browse a color library and a women’s and men’s hairstyle library, try shades on sample models, then sign in to upload your own photo and compare the before and after side by side. It is built for anyone who wants a low-risk way to plan a new look.
